name: Thal'darah Overlook
summary: Thal'darah Overlook is an Alliance encampment nestled high in the northern ridges of the Stonetalon Mountains, situated just south of sacred Stonetalon Peak. Anchored by a shimmering moonwell and gentle wisps, it serves as a secluded refuge for night elf sentinels watching the mountain trails.

sections.title: A Sentinel Watch in the Heights
sections.body: Perched along the craggy heights just south of Stonetalon Peak, Thal'darah Overlook acts as an essential outpost for the night elves. The high vantage point lets watchers survey the winding mountain paths below, where tensions with the Horde and the Venture Company continually press toward Kaldorei lands. Beneath the canopy of sacred woods, the encampment centers around a quiet moonwell, where wisps flutter between ancient boughs and sentinels keep vigil over the mountain passes.

faq.answer: Thal'darah Overlook is located in the northern region of the Stonetalon Mountains, nestled just south of the sacred sanctuary of Stonetalon Peak.
The outpost is controlled by the Alliance, specifically maintained by night elf sentinels and druids guarding the approaches to Stonetalon Peak.

faq.q: What landmarks are found in the camp?
faq.answer: The camp features an open-air night elf pavilion surrounding a consecrated moonwell, maintained alongside resident wisps that tend the nearby trees.

faq.q: How far is the Overlook from the Charred Vale?
faq.answer: Navigating the perilous trails through the craggy heights down to the blighted Charred Vale is a rugged journey that takes roughly two full days on foot.

angles.text: For night elves, the overlook is a tranquil and sacred staging ground safeguarding the sacred peak from encroaching industrial loggers and Horde incursions.
The camp provides Alliance wayfarers with a peaceful haven and a vital strategic vantage point overlooking Stonetalon's contested central pathways.
